messages:
Marta: quick upload 1F figma: https://figma.redwood/batch-tooltip-clarity 1F 
Liam: tidy! main flag: the export tooltip says 'CSV' but doesn't explain whether it includes score breakdowns or metadata
Sasha: agree. users assume everything will be in the CSV. we should add explicit copy in the tooltip like 'Exports selected vectors. Toggle metadata & breakdowns in export panel.'
Priya (a11y): accessibility: tooltip content must be reachable via keyboard and read by screen readers. make it focusable and use aria-describedby linking to the export button. avoid tiny font sizes so contrast meets AA
Devon: backend: we can return which optional columns are included in the estimate call. UI can show small badges in the tooltip: Metadata, Score breakdowns, Vector length. That also helps users predict filesize
Marta: propose tooltip copy: 'Export selected vectors (.csv). Click to open export options: include metadata, include score breakdowns. Estimated size shown before export.' keeps it short but clear
Liam: also add a micro-copy for the kebab menu: 'Export selected (.csv) 12 Toggle options in panel' so both discoverability and safety are improved
Sasha: small UX nit: tooltip should not be the only place explaining breakdowns. export panel must have an explicit toggle defaulting off for 'Include score breakdowns'
Priya (a11y): test cases: keyboard focus to export button -> tooltip announced -> enter opens panel -> toggle announced with aria-checked state. ensure focus returns after closing
Devon: will add the endpoint bits so UI can show exact toggles and size. ETA: PR next week
Marta: thanks all 1F I'll update the Figma frames with the new tooltip copy and a keyboard flow GIF and tag you when done
